name: Figma MCP Server
blurb: Design context, variables and screenshots straight from the file. Design to code in both directions.
useCase: Reading a design system before building a page
selectionBasis: Chosen for reading design files and design-system context before implementation.

name: Notion MCP
blurb: Pages and databases as tools. Where durable notes go when they leave the chat.
useCase: Turning session output into pages a team can find
selectionBasis: Chosen for keeping shared notes and databases accessible to agents.

name: Blender Lab MCP
blurb: Inspect a running Blender scene and work with its Python API through a local add-on. It can execute generated Python, so try it in an isolated environment.
useCase: Inspecting scene structure and spotting heavy geometry before editing
selectionBasis: Useful for scene analysis inside Blender, with direct access to the open file and the Python API.

name: Cloudflare API MCP
blurb: Search Cloudflare docs and use its API for DNS, Workers and R2 through a single remote MCP server.
useCase: Checking DNS records or Workers configuration before making a change
selectionBasis: Combines documentation and live account inspection. Start with read-only permissions.

name: Canva MCP
blurb: Designs, brand templates and exports as tools. Social cards without opening the editor.
useCase: Daily social assets from a brand template
selectionBasis: Chosen for producing repeatable assets from existing brand templates.

name: PixelLab MCP
blurb: Pixel-art characters, tilesets and animations generated as tools. Game assets without leaving the editor.
useCase: Sprites and tilesets for small game builds
selectionBasis: Chosen for pixel-art sprite and tileset workflows.

name: HubSpot MCP
blurb: CRM objects, campaigns and content analytics as tools. The sales side of the rack.
useCase: Pipeline questions answered from the CRM, not from memory
selectionBasis: Chosen for answering pipeline questions against CRM records.

name: Apollo MCP
blurb: People and company search, enrichment and sequences as tools, over remote HTTP with OAuth. People search costs no credits and enrichment does, so keep approval on for anything that spends.
useCase: Finding the buyer at a target company and enriching only the people worth contacting
selectionBasis: Chosen for buyer discovery and selective contact enrichment ahead of a CRM.

name: Asana MCP
blurb: Projects and tasks as tools, so status updates write themselves.
useCase: Closing the loop on tasks after a working session
selectionBasis: Chosen for carrying project decisions into assigned tasks.

name: Fireflies MCP
blurb: Meeting transcripts, summaries and action items as tools. Every call becomes searchable context.
useCase: Pulling decisions and owners out of a call transcript
selectionBasis: Chosen for retrieving meeting decisions, owners and transcript context.

name: TinyFish
blurb: Web search, page fetch and browser automation for agents. The eyes on the open web.
useCase: Current facts and page content before answering
selectionBasis: Chosen for web research that needs page retrieval and browser interaction.

name: Trigr MCP
blurb: Strategy building and backtesting for Hyperliquid perps, reachable from Claude over MCP. The research bench for trading ideas.
useCase: Drafting and backtesting a perps strategy from a chat
selectionBasis: Chosen for building and backtesting trading strategies from an AI client.
